name: NOVAPROM ICON DESIGN SYSTEM (reverse-engineered)
method: SVGs downloaded from /assets/templates/img/ico/**; parsed with lxml+svgelements (shapes outside <defs>/<clipPath>), bbox incl. stroke/2, rendered with cairosvg at 4-12 px/unit; ink = alpha>=0.5; full-canvas white <rect> backgrounds excluded. Per-icon raw data: icon-metrics.json; family aggregates: icon-family-summary.json.

authoring_fingerprint.tool: Figma-style SVG export (root fill="none", explicit width/height = viewBox, stroke-miterlimit="10" on every stroked path, flat list of <path> with no groups/transforms/classes/ids, occasional clipPath0 wrapper)
authoring_fingerprint.coordinate_precision: mostly 1 decimal in tile family, float artifacts up to 4-6 decimals

palette.note: #4D7C90 appears ONLY inside the SVG icons; it is not in the site CSS. Site CSS brand colours are #FDB913 / #1C1C1C / #FFFFFF.

tile.role: Primary product/category illustrations (catalogue tiles, sub-category cards). This is the core equipment icon style.

display_size_css_px.sub-category cards: height 174 px, object-fit:contain -> ~239 px wide, scale ~1.09

widths_units.1: detail/secondary lines (448 shapes, ~74% of stroke length median)
widths_units.2: primary silhouette & key features (128 shapes, median 26.5% of stroke length, range 17-54.5%)

fill.strategy: Closed bodies filled with #F5F5F5 to occlude hidden lines (hidden-line removal), never as a visible colour block; 274 filled vs 579 stroked shapes (fill/stroke shape ratio median 0.5)

geometry.projection: Three-quarter perspective view (not isometric, not orthographic): verticals strictly vertical, receding edges at shallow +/-4..12 deg from horizontal, no 30 deg isometric axes

curve_radius_units.note: cubic-approximated arcs; no <circle>/<ellipse>/<rect rx>/arc commands - everything is <path> with C/L/H/V

geometry.shading: vertical parallel rules clustered toward one side of cylinders to suggest curvature (no gradients/hatching fills)

padding_pct.range: 0-25% (no fixed safe area: drawings are scaled per subject, tall subjects touch top/bottom, wide ones touch sides)

outliers: ico-tile-6: clipPath + geometry touches/overflows top & bottom (0 / -0.4 units)
ico-tile-8: uses 0.75 stroke width; 2px strokes = 48% of length

dropdown.role: Same equipment drawings, simplified, inverted for the dark mega-menu (Продукция dropdown)

fill.strategy: #1C1C1C occluder fill (= menu background) so only amber lines read

layout.vertical_safe_area: geometry spans y=8..42 in 4/7 icons (8-unit = 16% top/bottom inset; padding incl. stroke 7.5 units)

outliers: ico-drop-11: clipPath, geometry overflows left edge by 0.5 units

logistics (smpl-ico-1..3: truck, plane,.fills: small #FDB913 solid accents (wheels), plane uses #FFFFFF fill
logistics (smpl-ico-1..3: truck, plane,.background: opaque full-canvas white <rect> (cannot sit on non-white bg)

inline_ui.role: UI glyphs on затворы pages (document, download)
inline_ui.stroke: currentColor via CSS, width 1.7-1.8, round caps & joins
inline_ui.note: Lucide/Feather-like; not part of the equipment icon system

logo.mark: 6 triangular segments forming a hexagonal aperture (same motif as smpl-ico-6), geometric constructed wordmark, fills only, fill-rule evenodd

ui_decor.note: hexagon outlines (30deg sides) used as section background decor, stroke 1, #5C5B5B at 30% opacity or white

png_tiles.style: full-colour glossy 3D renders (yellow/blue/grey), unrelated to the line-art SVG system

reproduction_rules_for_new_icons: Canvas 220x160 (product tiles) / 65x50 (menu); export at 1:1 with width/height = viewBox.
Draw equipment in a three-quarter perspective: verticals truly vertical; receding horizontals at 4-12 deg; avoid isometric 30 deg and 45 deg diagonals.

Stroke only #4D7C90 (light UI) or #FDB913 (dark UI). Two weights: 2 units for the foreground silhouette and key features (~20-30% of total line length), 1 unit for internal detail and background objects.
Fill every closed body with #F5F5F5 (light) or #1C1C1C (dark) purely to hide lines behind it; no gradients, no opacity, no shadows.
Cylinders: elliptical ends with minor/major ~0.45-0.65; flanges as stacked ellipses; suggest curvature with 3-8 vertical rules clustered to one side.
Center the drawing horizontally exactly (bbox centre = canvas centre); scale the subject so it fills ~75-80% of width/height (ink ~35-40% of canvas incl. fills).
Detail budget: 20-60 paths, 50-200 nodes for tile icons; 9-25 paths, 30-80 nodes for menu icons.
